title: Kunshan police “AI police” models flag a mobile gambling ring at Zhouzhuang, 20-plus arrested on 10 September 2024, and trace a telecom fraud's card transfers to freeze 500,000 yuan within 10 minutes
summary: Kunshan police say their “AI police” models led a 10 September 2024 bust of a mobile gambling ring (20-plus arrests) and froze 500,000 yuan of a 980,000-yuan telecom fraud within 10 minutes.
account: On 10 September 2024, the Kunshan Public Security Bureau in Jiangsu broke up a gang running a mobile open-air casino in Zhouzhuang town and arrested more than 20 suspects; Modern Express reported that the “AI police”, models that detect outdoor gambling from behavioral patterns in bulk data, had found the ring (NetEase reprint, 6 October 2024). In a telecom fraud handled by the Lujia police station, in which a victim lost 980,000 yuan, the models traced three tiers of card transfers and froze 500,000 yuan within 10 minutes, identified 87 suspect accounts within 8 hours, and nine suspects were arrested on the third day with 200,000 yuan recovered (Suzhou Daily via suzhou.gov.cn, 7 October 2024). The models were built by the “Kunpeng Squad”, 35 officers assembled in May 2024, who report more than 220 models and, over six months, 609 fraud cases solved and 32.47 million yuan recovered (both sources). All figures are the police's own.
purpose: Models built by the Kunshan police to detect crime patterns and trace funds for investigators; the bust and the freeze were that purpose.
system: Kunshan Public Security Bureau 'AI police' (AI警察): more than 220 'main-attack, main-defense' intelligent models built by the Kunpeng Squad
developer: Kunshan Public Security Bureau, Kunpeng Squad (鲲鹏战队), with Suzhou Public Security Bureau support
taxonomy_note: The quantified outcome is a fraud loss partly averted (500,000 yuan frozen), which is Reduced Risk; the dated gambling bust is a crime stopped, Trustible's Reduced Violence, but the offense was nonviolent.

ratings.reason: The fraud victim who lost 980,000 yuan had 500,000 yuan frozen within 10 minutes and 200,000 yuan recovered after the arrests, per the police; whether the frozen sum was returned is not reported.

The Kunshan bureau reports a 20-plus-suspect bust, nine fraud arrests within three days and 609 fraud cases solved in six months with recovery rates up 62%; a measurable gain for the unit, on its own figures.
The six-month aggregate of 32.47 million yuan recovered is the deployer's own claim with no method or independent check, so no population effect is established.

ai_role.statement: Both accounts are the police's. They credit the models with flagging the outdoor casino from behavioral features in bulk data, mapping the ring's structure “with one click”, and tracing card-tier fund flows in parallel so that a freeze came within 10 minutes; officers made the arrests and the freeze requests. Deputy criminal-investigation chief He Yongliang describes the gain as 24-hour, parallel rather than serial casework. Neither source separates the models' share from ordinary investigation.
